messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Triplet: ["200 mg capsule", "contains", "224 mg sertraline hydrochloride"]

The relation 'contains' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity includes or comprises the specified quantity of the substance mentioned in the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
B. 'require': The object entity is a required component or substance of the subject entity.
C. 'may appear in': A part of the subject entity may be present or appear in the entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'can build up in': The subject substance may accumulate in the body or within the specified entity.
E. 'has reference product': The subject entity has a reference product, which is specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
